overview: This event pulls together olf entry, olf and rdo communication, and crosswind takeoff and landings into a cumulative review brief. You should be ready to move between sections without a reset and explain the setup cues, decision points, and common misses that usually trigger follow-up questions.

studyNotes.headline: Discussion items

items.text: OLF Entry is judged by how well you enter it, stay ahead of the aircraft, and recover without needing cleanup coaching.

Arrival Procedures

Before entering the pattern, make a call to the RDO (Runway Duty Officer).
If no response by 2 NM, execute discontinued entry.
Switch to UHF CH 14 for ASOS.
If no radio contact by Shrimp Ponds, or pattern full, fly south and contact Corpus Approach (CH 8).
Announce intentions on CTAF (CH 21 VHF) and report "High-Key" on KRKP common (CH 21 UHF).
